engine: crownd/finest's section entrance — a whole full-bleed MEDIA BLOCK rises up from below (translateY riseY -> 0) and fades in (0 -> 1) as it scrolls into view, ONCE, power3.out, with a hair of scale-settle. The simplest, lightest 'rise': the WHOLE block moves as one — no per-element masking, no cover, no theme-flip, no pin. Harvested from D_finest (F4: a full-bleed media block rises into view on the warm-paper page).
family_note: DISTINCT from the two rise-cousins (kept separate on purpose): scroll-clip-rise (Saisei) = each ELEMENT rises from a bottom CLIP-MASK (image column + text LINE BY LINE) — element-level masked reveal. panel-rise-over (11tanjung) = a coloured PANEL slides OVER the previous section + theme-flip + rounded top, PINNED — a cover transition. section-rise-into-view (this) = the WHOLE block translateY+fade on enter, NO mask, NO cover, NO theme-flip, NO pin — the lightest of the three, for plain media/section entrances.

measured_teardown.move: on enter (start ~'top 85%') each [data-rise-block] plays once: opacity 0 -> 1 + translateY riseY(80-90px) -> 0 + optional scale scaleFrom(0.98) -> 1, power3.out, with an optional per-block stagger when several. The whole block is one transform target — there is NO clip-path/mask (that's the scroll-clip-rise distinction) and NO cover/pin (that's the panel-rise-over distinction). set(p) is a PURE scrub for previews.
measured_teardown.cited: finest: a full-bleed media block rises up from below into view as you scroll, on the warm-paper page, followed by the next heading.

riseY.what: how far below its resting spot the block starts (translateY) before rising to 0.

scaleFrom.what: starting scale (1 = pure rise; 0.98 = a hair of scale-settle for extra life). Eases to 1.

stagger.what: delay between blocks when several share one create() (each still fires on its own enter).

start.what: ScrollTrigger start — when a block is far enough into view to play.

once.what: play once (true) or replay / reset on leave-back (false).

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when the page drives a shared Lenis (lab sets false).

entry: SectionRiseIntoView.create(target, opts) -> { triggers, lenis, set(p), play(), refresh(), destroy }. target wraps one or more [data-rise-block] (each a full-bleed media block / section). set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of the rise across all blocks (preview).
law: transform: translateY + scale + opacity only; GPU; NO clip-mask, NO mix-blend, NO backdrop; NO WebGL; reduced-motion or <=820px -> shown (no play). owns_pin false (a plain scroll-into-view reveal, not pinned, not a cover). GSAP + ScrollTrigger required for the scroll path; set(p) standalone.
gate_mode: scroll-into-view reveal (not pinned). Verify: each block rises translateY riseY -> 0 + fades 0 -> 1 on enter; NO clip-path (clip=none — the distinguishing trait vs scroll-clip-rise); not pinned, no cover (vs panel-rise-over). Smoothness via the scroll path.
proven: lab: 3 full-bleed media blocks on OUR QUADRO renders (macro-table / terrace / night) with serif captions. Curve measured live (set p / opacity / translateY / clip): 0 / 0.00 / 90px / none -> 0.5 / 0.88 / 11.3px / none -> 1 / 1.00 / 0px / none. clip-path = none at all p (confirms NO mask — distinct from scroll-clip-rise). Block 2 opacity -> 1.00 on scroll-into-view. Screenshot (mid-rise 0.55): a QUADRO interior media block partway up + serif caption 'Інтер'єр, прорахований до деталі', next block peeking (matches finest F4). Probe (4x CPU throttle, scroll): 2/796 long frames (0.3%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors.
